notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact creature.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Ob Nixilis' second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ob Nixilis.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
